registry_insertion_point: Immediately inside makeChecks() returned registry object, before existing first entry. Uses existing smokeResult helper; no extra dependencies.

old.asserts: n/v=3/4; the homogeneous log likelihood n log ρ−vρ is maximized at ρ=3/4.
The normalized log likelihood relative to unit Poisson is 4(1−ρ); it increases to 4 as ρ↓0 and equals 4 at ρ=0 only when admitted.

new.asserts: For $n=0$, that log likelihood reduces to $-4\rho$ for $\rho>0$; it tends to $0$ as $\rho\downarrow0$ and is strictly smaller at every positive rate.

old.asserts: Exact and pseudo likelihood observation ratios agree; their ratio is the constant e^4.
Exact ratio g(δx)/g(0)=2; pseudo ratio is 2 exp(a), hence is strictly greater than 2 exp(4/25)>2.

new.asserts: The ratio of exact to pseudo likelihood is the observation-independent constant $e^4$.

The square $[4/5,6/5]^2$ lies inside the radius-$1/2$ ball about $x$, so $a\ge4/25>0$ by [F12]. Hence $\exp\{\beta(1-\gamma)a\}>1$ by [F11], and the pseudo ratio is strictly larger than the exact ratio $\beta$.

required_parameters: Use top-level finite_smoke object parameters. Strict explicit fixture validation matches the finite square/empty/singleton models; defaults allow ordinary registry self-test but are not relied on by the contracts. Nested input is not consumed by runSmoke.
limitations: Finite witness computations only; positive-rate grid/score signs are not a proof of all-rate maximization, and disk/square numerical arithmetic does not certify the full theorem. Existing local proofs remain mandatory.
